product_desc: The MSI MS-7817 is a desktop PC, often featuring the MSI H81M-P33 motherboard, designed for everyday computing tasks.

product_features.Processor: Intel Core i3-4130 CPU @ 3.40GHz (compatible with 4th Generation Intel Core i3/i5/i7, Pentium, and Celeron processors)
product_features.Graphics: Intel Corporation 4th Generation Core Processor Family Integrated Graphics Controller
product_features.Expansion Slots: 1 x PCIe 2.0 x16, 2 x PCIe 2.0 x1
product_features.Ports: 2 x USB 3.0 (rear), 4 x USB 2.0 (rear/internal headers), 1 x VGA, 1 x DVI, Audio ports (rear), 1 x PS/2 keyboard port
product_features.Security Features: TPM (header), Anti-ESD ICs and fuses on-board, optimized EMI-proof design
product_features.Manageability: Desktop Management Interface (DMI) function for motherboard specifications
product_features.Special Features: Military Class 4: Top Quality & Stability, OC Genie, Click BIOS 4, M-Flash, Fast Boot
